title: Recover the owner using the saved code
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Accept the existing owner username, recovery code and a new password. Consume the code and offer a replacement after verified sign-in.

**Verify** · Exercise successful reset, replay of the consumed code and failed recovery. The owner keeps the same Home and old sessions lose access.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-059, WI-064

**Queue** · Follows WI-067 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
